objective: Proof. Classes 1, 2 and 5 have five-point link pieces. Every other class that fails on small systems (4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 12) has a three-point piece realizing a relation of the twelve class, so lifting the twelve class's link piece line by line gives a link piece. With a regularization for arbitrary link pieces and Schaefer's theorem, every such class is NP-complete on 4-regular systems, and its failures are coNP-complete to recognise. Check the realizations, the lifted links (by SAT) and the regularization end to end.
status: Proved by FOUR-PREFER-20261101-001B-P001: classes 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10 and 12 build links (class 1 directly; the others by realizing the twelve class on a three-point core and lifting its link piece to 23 internal points), so with a regularization for link pieces of any size and Schaefer they are NP-complete on 4-regular 4-uniform systems and their failures are coNP-complete; 240/240 end to end against a SAT solver
title: Every failing class builds a link
